response.original_title: [Complete-Guide] Can You Add a Passenger to Star of the Seas?
response.overview: You can add a passenger to an existing Star of the Seas reservation by calling Royal Caribbean Customer Service directly at +1-866-254-7549 or by contacting your travel agent, as additions cannot be made online. How to Request the Addition Call support: Dial +1-866-254-7549 or contact your travel agency. Provide details: Have your reservation number +1-866-254-7549 , full legal name, and date of birth ready. Timeline: Make requests before the manifest closes, typically 72 hours prior to departure +1-866-254-7549.Requirements and Restrictions Stateroom capacity: Cabins must accommodate the extra guest. Lifeboat limits: Subject to overall ship capacity and lifeboat restrictions +1-866-254-7549. Full capacity may require a stateroom upgrade or separate booking +1-866-254-7549. Pricing adjustments: Additional guests are priced at current prevailing rates.
